title: Five Tips for Learning Astrology for Beginners
description:
Here are my top five tips for learning astrology, for people who are new to the subject and want to learn how to read birth charts. 

Here are my five tips for studying astrology in order: 

1. Get a copy of your birth chart from astro.com

2. Memorize the symbols for the planets and zodiac signs.

3. Get some astrology books and read them. 

4. Start following your transits on a regular basis.

5. Study the birth charts and transits of people you know.

Do these five steps, and you will be well on your way to becoming an astrologer in no time.
